title: Order in the Evaluation Court: A Critical Analysis of NLG Evaluation Trends
reasoning: The paper is a meta-analysis and systematic review of evaluation practices in the field of Natural Language Generation (NLG). While it analyzes the usage of evaluation criteria such as 'safety' and 'harmlessness' (common in AI ethics alignment), the work does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or faith directly; its focus is on methodological trends.
